changes.summary: Corrected public build egress for the pinned LTX source archive and PyTorch wheel redirects.
changes.details: Added codeload.github.com and download-r2.pytorch.org, and removed nvcr.io because verified base images are transferred separately from Dockerfile build egress.

changes.summary: Selected the pinned upstream's explicit disk-streaming offload mode for the LTX-2 19B dev FP4 single-Spark Candidate.
changes.details: The FP4-only adapter now requests disk rather than CPU offload and remains bound exclusively to this recipe. Pinned upstream quantifies disk offload at about 5 GB host RAM plus 5 GB accelerator memory versus about 36 GB host RAM plus 5 GB accelerator memory for CPU offload. The conservative Candidate envelope subtracts only that documented 31 GB host-memory delta: startup 120 to 89 GB and steady 106 to 75 GB, with growth and system reserve unchanged at 8 GB each. Admission therefore requires 97 GB including reserve; physical acceptance remains pending.

changes.summary: Refreshed the native pipeline from LTX 1.2 to exact 1.3.0 source and its named six-field PipelineOutput contract.
changes.details: The adapter fails closed unless ltx-pipelines is version 1.3.0 and PipelineOutput exposes video, audio, num_frames, tiling_config, keyframes, and video_latent.

changes.summary: Replaced live Git package resolution with a checksummed source archive and added the required TorchVision and cuDNN 9.24 pins.
changes.details: The FP4 build now uses the same deterministic archive and dependency-lock path as the other native LTX adapters.

changes.summary: Kept the declared two-stage interface and conservative memory envelope while inheriting upstream decode-tiling OOM fixes.
changes.details: LTX 1.3 contains DFR and keyframe-aware decode support, but this recipe does not claim those artifact-dependent paths and remains a physical-acceptance Candidate.

changes.summary: Filtered the pinned Hugging Face snapshot to the 25 immutable files required by the native FP4 runtime.
changes.details: The checkpoint, distilled LoRA, spatial upscaler, Gemma shards and indexes, and tokenizer closure remain byte-identical. Repository metadata and unrelated checkpoints are no longer downloaded. Gemma now receives the common root containing both text_encoder and tokenizer. The image/build allowance matches the conservative 8 GB envelope used by the same pinned LTX 1.2 runtime family.

changes.summary: Replaced the hidden default prompt with one required bounded UTF-8 prompt file and declared exact synchronized-MP4 output bounds.
Removed automatic duration for the legacy checkpoint by fixing 97 frames at 768x512/24 fps and validating synchronized H.264/AAC before publication.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Replaced unavailable ARM64 CUDA 13.2 Torch and TorchAudio pins with the current upstream-tested 2.13.0 and 2.11.0 wheels.
Corrected the recipe's whole-snapshot artifact and dependent disk resource sizes.
The candidate still requires an ARM64 container build and physical Spark canary before acceptance.
Initial reviewed catalog release of LTX-2 19B dev FP4 native pipeline single Spark.
